# mosaic psychology

> English-speaking psychology practice in Maastricht offering specialized counselling for creative professionals, neurodivergent adults, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and expat families.

Mine Hasırcı is a psychologist based in Maastricht, Netherlands, providing both in-person and online counselling services. The practice specializes in evidence-based approaches including CBT, ACT, and Schema Therapy, with particular expertise in supporting creative professionals, neurodivergent individuals with ADHD and autism, and LGBTQIA+ clients.
